subject: Catering Craft Practice
examFormat: Three papers; Papers 1 and 2 are combined in a 1 1/2 hour composite paper. Paper 1: forty multiple-choice questions in 40 minutes for 40 marks. Paper 2: six short essay questions, answer five, in 50 minutes for 40 marks. Paper 3: an alternative to practical test with five short structured questions, all answered, in 40 minutes for 40 marks.

subtopics.name: Hospitality industry/catering
objectives: Define hospitality and catering
Identify the components of the hospitality industry

subtopics.name: Types of catering establishments
objectives: Identify the types of catering establishment, e.g. hotel, restaurant, hospitality catering, outdoor catering, school, mobile catering
State the functions of catering establishments

subtopics.name: Culinary terms
objectives: Use culinary terms commonly used in catering
Use the glossary of culinary terms

subtopics.name: Safety precaution in catering
objectives: Identify the types and causes of accidents
Describe prevention and management of accidents
Apply first aid
Identify fire fighting equipment

subtopics.name: Sanitation and hygiene in catering
objectives: Describe the types of sanitation and hygiene: water sanitation, environmental sanitation, food safety practices, kitchen hygiene, personal hygiene

topics.name: Food Commodities and Methods of Food Preparation

subtopics.name: Study of food commodities and principles of cooking methods
objectives: Identify food commodities, e.g. poultry, game, meat, fish, vegetables, fruits, dairy products, pulses, cereals, herbs, flavourings
Describe methods of cooking: boiling (e.g. stock, soups and sauces), roasting (e.g. fish, beef and poultry), grilling (e.g. fish, meat), baking (e.g. pastry and confectionery)

subtopics.name: Principles of cooking methods and practical demonstrations
objectives: Explain the principles of cooking methods
Prepare the various food commodities
Use standard/local measurements

subtopics.name: Food and beverage service personnel
objectives: Identify the personnel in the food and beverage area
State the functions of food and beverage personnel

subtopics.name: Types of food service and table laying/setting
objectives: Describe types of food service, e.g. gueridon, silver service, waiter service, vending, buffet and banquet service
Identify the types of covers
Describe types of table laying/setting

subtopics.name: Types of alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks
objectives: Describe the bar
Identify alcoholic beverages
Identify non-alcoholic beverages

subtopics.name: Costing and control in catering
objectives: Calculate cost/sales
Calculate dish costing
Apply portion control

subtopics.name: Types of kitchen equipment and their uses
objectives: Identify kitchen equipment
State the uses of kitchen equipment

subtopics.name: Care and maintenance of kitchen equipment
objectives: Care for various kitchen equipment
Maintain kitchen equipment

subtopics.name: Principles of menu planning
objectives: State the meaning and scope of a menu
State the factors that affect menu planning

subtopics.name: Types of menu and demonstrations
objectives: Identify types of menu, e.g. table d'hote, a la carte and special occasions
Identify other menus: breakfast, tea, dinner, supper, luncheon, carte du jour, plat du jour

subtopics.name: Special menu and demonstrations
objectives: Plan meals for vegetarians
Plan meals for the vulnerable group
Plan meals for manual and sedentary workers

subtopics.name: Accompaniments
objectives: Identify food accompaniments
Identify table accompaniments
